66: /-- o gerador modular como superoperador: `K = R_{logρ} − L_{logρ}`
67:     (= −δ_{logρ}; a face finita de `K_Ψ = −log Δ_Ψ`). -/
68: def modularGen (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (y : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
69:   y * logRho ρ - logRho ρ * y

71: /-- [KERNEL] o gerador é a excitação do log com sinal trocado:
72:     `K = −δ_{logρ}` (a ponte com v48/v54: transporte infinitesimal). -/
73: theorem modularGen_eq_neg_excite (ρ y : Matrix n n ℂ) :
74:     modularGen ρ y = - excite (logRho ρ) y := by
75:   unfold modularGen excite
76:   rw [neg_sub]
77: 
78: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O ZERO MODULAR: `K_Ψ Ω_Ψ = 0` — o gerador anula o NOME
79:     (o modo zero do gerador modular, NÃO o operador nulo). -/
80: theorem modularGen_omega_zero (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hρ : ρ.PosDef) :
81:     modularGen ρ (Omega ρ) = 0 := by
82:   have hc : Commute ρ (Omega ρ) := rho_comm_omega ρ hρ
83:   have hl : Commute (logRho ρ) (Omega ρ) := hc.cfc_real Real.log
84:   unfold modularGen
85:   rw [← hl.eq, sub_self]

87: /-- [KERNEL] ★ A PARIDADE INVERSA: `J K J = −K` — a conjugação modular
88:     inverte o gerador (a forma rigorosa de "a paridade inversa"). -/
89: theorem J_modularGen_J (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (y : Matrix n n ℂ) :
90:     Jconj (modularGen ρ (Jconj y)) = - modularGen ρ y := by
91:   unfold modularGen Jconj
92:   rw [conjTranspose_sub, conjTranspose_mul, conjTranspose_mul,
93:     conjTranspose_conjTranspose, logRho_conjTranspose, neg_sub]

27: def Admissible {Y : Type u} {O : Type v} (reading : Y → O) (target : O) (y : Y) : Prop :=
28:   reading y = target

30: def SoundRule {Y : Type u} {O : Type v} (reading : Y → O) (target : O)
31:     (C : Y → Prop) : Prop := ∀ y : Y, C y → reading y = target

33: def CompleteRule {Y : Type u} {O : Type v} (reading : Y → O) (target : O)
34:     (C : Y → Prop) : Prop := ∀ y : Y, reading y = target → C y

72: /-- A selection is required to preserve the chosen reading; this is not inferred
73: from idempotence. The image is its fixed locus, as proved below. -/
74: structure ReadingRetraction {Y : Type u} {O : Type v} (reading : Y → O) (R : Y → Y) : Prop where
75:   idempotent : ∀ y : Y, R (R y) = R y
76:   preserves_reading : ∀ y : Y, reading (R y) = reading y
77: 
78: theorem admissible_retract_iff {Y : Type u} {O : Type v}
79:     (reading : Y → O) (target : O) (R : Y → Y)
80:     (hR : ReadingRetraction reading R) (y : Y) :
81:     Admissible reading target (R y) ↔ Admissible reading target y := by
82:   unfold Admissible
83:   rw [hR.preserves_reading y]

130: theorem admissible_iff_eq_of_injective {Y : Type u} {O : Type v}
131:     (reading : Y → O) (target : O) (hinj : Function.Injective reading)
132:     (y0 : Y) (h0 : reading y0 = target) (y : Y) :
133:     Admissible reading target y ↔ y = y0 := by
134:   constructor
135:   · intro hy
136:     exact hinj (hy.trans h0.symm)
137:   · intro hy
138:     cases hy
139:     exact h0

65: theorem flow_preserves_rule (E : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (hE : ∀ x, E (E x) = E x)
66:     (target x : V) (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
67:     Admissible E target (orbit E rate frequency time x) ↔ Admissible E target x := by
68:   unfold Admissible
69:   rw [orbit_center hE]

71: theorem flow_inscription_is_stationary (E : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
72:     (hE : ∀ x, E (E x) = E x) (x : V) (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
73:     inscribe E hE (orbit E rate frequency time x) = inscribe E hE x := by
74:   apply Subtype.ext

79:     (x : V) (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
80:     inscribe E hE (orbit E rate frequency time x) = target ↔ E x = target.val := by
81:   rw [flow_inscription_is_stationary]

104:     (hx : x ≠ E x) (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
105:     orbit E rate frequency time x ≠ E x := by
